release.changeNote: Seedance 2, 2 Fast, 2 Mini and 2.5, MiniMax H3, Wan 2.7, Wan 3.0 and 3.0 Prime and Kling 2.6 motion publish the shortest clip or track Kie takes, as minDurationSeconds on the slot: 2 s on the Seedance 2 family's and MiniMax H3's videoReferences and audioReferences, 1 s on Wan 3.0 and 3.0 Prime's and on Wan 2.7's audioReferences, and 3 s on Kling 2.6's referenceVideo. Each is read from the start's own table (src/lib/provider-input-limits.ts), which already refused a shorter file before any hold, but only once Generate was pressed; the creators now hold the run before Generate. Kling 3.0 motion keeps its compatibility descriptor: re-emitting it would also move its pricing and validation off motion-v1. No price, quote rule, other slot, model or platform changes.
